f3_program: observe(at("jorge.property.area", "last_year"), 60, "acre", source("60 acres of property"))
same(at("jorge.property.corn_planted_area", "last_year"), at("jorge.property.area", "last_year"), source("planted corn on all of his 60 acres of property"))
observe(at("corn.good_soil.yield_rate", "typical"), 400, "bushel_per_acre", source("corn grown on good soil yields 400 bushels per acre"))
fraction_of(at("corn.clay_rich_soil.yield_rate", "typical"), at("corn.good_soil.yield_rate", "typical"), 1, 2, source("in clay-rich soil, the yield is only half as much per acre as in good soil"))
fraction_of(at("jorge.property.clay_rich_soil.area", "last_year"), at("jorge.property.area", "last_year"), 1, 3, source("One-third of Jorge's 60 acres of land is clay-rich soil"))

sum_relation(at("jorge.property.area", "last_year"), at("jorge.property.clay_rich_soil.area", "last_year"), at("jorge.property.good_soil.area", "last_year"), source("One-third of Jorge's 60 acres of land is clay-rich soil and the rest is good soil"))
query("value", at("jorge.property.corn_yield", "last_year"))
assumptions: The stated typical soil-specific yield rates are intended to apply to Jorge's corn last year.

f3_program: observe(at("amalia.reading.pages.count", "reference"), 4, "count", source("Amalia can read 4 pages of her book in 2 minutes"))
observe(at("amalia.reading.duration", "reference"), 2, "minute", source("Amalia can read 4 pages of her book in 2 minutes"))
rate_relation("amalia.reading.pages.count", "amalia.reading.page_rate", "amalia.reading.duration", source("Amalia can read 4 pages of her book in 2 minutes"))
observe(at("amalia.reading.pages.count", "target"), 18, "count", source("read 18 pages of her book"))
query("value", at("amalia.reading.duration", "target"))
assumptions: Amalia reads the target pages at the same rate as in the stated reference interval.

f3_program: collection("jeanine.pencils", "pencil", "jeanine", source("Jeanine bought 18 pencils"))
add("jeanine_purchase", "jeanine", at("jeanine.pencils.count", "current"), 18, source("Jeanine bought 18 pencils"))
collection("clare.pencils", "pencil", "clare", source("Clare bought half as many pencils"))
add("clare_purchase", "clare", at("clare.pencils.count", "current"), fraction(event_field("jeanine_purchase", "quantity"), 1, 2), source("Clare bought half as many pencils"))

transfer("jeanine_to_abby", "jeanine", at("jeanine.pencils.count", "current"), at("abby.pencils.count", "current"), fraction(event_field("jeanine_purchase", "quantity"), 1, 3), source("Jeanine gave one third of his pencils to Abby"))
query("difference", at("clare.pencils.count", "now"), at("jeanine.pencils.count", "now"))
assumptions: The pronoun his refers to Jeanine, and the pencil holdings in scope are the pencils described by the purchases.

f3_program: collection("cole.backyard.fence_segments", "fence_segment", "cole.backyard", source("fence his backyard on three sides"))
observe(at("cole.backyard.fence.left_side.length", "current"), 9, "foot", source("9 feet along the sides"))
observe(at("cole.backyard.fence.right_side.length", "current"), 9, "foot", source("9 feet along the sides"))
observe(at("cole.backyard.fence.back_side.length", "current"), 18, "foot", source("18 feet along the back"))
observe(at("fencing.cost_rate", "current"), 3, "dollar_per_foot", source("Fencing costs $3 per foot"))

fraction_of(at("cole.backyard.fence.back_neighbor.payment", "planned"), at("cole.backyard.fence.back_side.cost", "planned"), 1, 2, source("The neighbor behind him agreed to pay for half of their shared side of his fence"))

fraction_of(at("cole.backyard.fence.left_neighbor.payment", "planned"), at("cole.backyard.fence.left_side.cost", "planned"), 1, 3, source("the neighbor on his left agreed to pay for a third of their shared side"))
query("value", at("cole.backyard.fence.cole_payment", "planned"))
assumptions: The three fenced segments are the left and right 9-foot sides and the 18-foot back, and each neighbor's fraction applies to the cost of that shared segment.

f3_program: collection("lucille.mom.garden.weeds", "weed", "lucille.mom.garden", source("every weed she pulled in her mom's garden"))
observe(at("lucille.mom.garden.flower_bed.weeds.count", "initial"), 11, "count", source("eleven weeds in the flower bed"))
observe(at("lucille.mom.garden.vegetable_patch.weeds.count", "initial"), 14, "count", source("fourteen in the vegetable patch"))
observe(at("lucille.mom.garden.grass_around_fruit_trees.weeds.count", "initial"), 32, "count", source("thirty-two in the grass around the fruit trees"))
observe(at("lucille.earnings.rate", "agreement"), 6, "cent_per_weed", source("six cents for every weed she pulled"))

rate_relation(at("lucille.earnings.cent", "before_break"), at("lucille.earnings.rate", "agreement"), at("lucille.weeds_pulled.count", "before_break"), source("she would earn six cents for every weed she pulled in her mom's garden"))

remove("weed_flower_bed", "lucille", at("lucille.mom.garden.flower_bed.weeds.count", "current"), at("lucille.mom.garden.flower_bed.weeds.count", "initial"), source("Lucille weeded the flower bed, the vegetable patch, and half the grass"))

remove("weed_vegetable_patch", "lucille", at("lucille.mom.garden.vegetable_patch.weeds.count", "current"), at("lucille.mom.garden.vegetable_patch.weeds.count", "initial"), source("Lucille weeded the flower bed, the vegetable patch, and half the grass"))

remove("weed_grass", "lucille", at("lucille.mom.garden.grass_around_fruit_trees.weeds.count", "current"), fraction(at("lucille.mom.garden.grass_around_fruit_trees.weeds.count", "initial"), 1, 2), source("Lucille weeded the flower bed, the vegetable patch, and half the grass"))
remove("buy_soda", "lucille", at("lucille.earnings.cent", "current"), 99, source("She bought a soda for 99 cents on her break with some of her earnings"))
query("value", at("lucille.earnings.cent", "current"))
assumptions: The source uses half the grass to mean half of the 32 weeds located in the grass around the fruit trees, while weeding the flower bed and vegetable patch means pulling all weeds counted there.
